description.value: Rossland Pool is a public swimming facility operated by the City of Rossland, located on Columbia Avenue in this historic mountain town in the West Kootenay region of BC. Rossland is well known among cyclists for its mountain biking trails and its position along scenic routes through the Kootenays, making the pool a potential refreshing stop for touring riders.
